spell.bhspellsx.embracing_bosom.guide: Channel to plant a warding circle at your feet. Players standing in it are healed periodically and take reduced damage while blessed; harmful effects applied to them expire faster.
spell.bhspellsx.amethyst_decree.guide: Channel to erupt a burst of amethyst around you. Enemies caught in the blast take heavy damage, are rooted and stunned, and are weakened while lingering crystal damage wears them down.
spell.bhspellsx.crystal_hydro_dome.guide: Raise a warding dome of water and crystal around you. Allies inside are cleansed and healed, damage they take is redirected into the dome's own strength, and outside attackers are struck back with lightning. Incoming projectiles are blocked or reflected at the boundary.
spell.bhspellsx.xian_she_huan_ying.guide: Toggle to lock onto the target you are looking at. While locked they are slowed and you are empowered; it ends when you toggle it off, run out of mana, either of you dies, or you change dimension.
